statements: CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS mysql_slowlog_repro
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events (id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP NULL, payload VARCHAR(64) NULL, KEY idx_status (status))
INSERT INTO events (id, status, created_at, payload) SELECT n, CASE WHEN n <= 1000 * 0.95 THEN 'hot' ELSE 'cold' END, NOW(), CONCAT('p', n) FROM (SELECT 1 AS n) AS seed
